caption_draft:
Your project deserves a demo. These 6 free tools record it.

OBS Studio — https://obsproject.com/ — Free, open-source screen recorder
Snipping Tool — https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/use-snipping-tool-to-capture-screenshots — Built into Windows, records too
Mac Screenshot app — https://support.apple.com/en-in/102618 — Shift + Command + 5 to record
ShareX — https://getsharex.com/ — Free; records video and GIFs
Loom — https://support.atlassian.com/loom/docs/available-loom-plans/ — Free: 25 videos, 5 min each
Clipchamp — https://clipchamp.com/en/pricing/ — 1080p free exports, no watermark

Save this for the day your project works. Send it to the friend who built something and never showed it.

#projectdemo #screenrecording #buildinpublic #firstyear #students #webdev #coding #notyourcollege
